requires: Existing local monitor API on 127.0.0.1:8766; Node >=20. Use a new experiment directory for another run because output files refuse overwrite.
limits: One short anonymous observation, not a reliability or tick-latency benchmark
Six symbol/timeframe requests and one 20-second stream
No production UI, scanner, notification or account changes
Price parity only; volume units were not normalized
Monday anchor parity and reconnect behavior were not tested
No browser was launched; all data sessions stopped and the probe process exited
